headline: Home, browse, and seed data are in main: 19 of the 21 Prototype units are done. What is left waits on you: the Blob stores (U-010 photos), whether cards show photos (no unit owns it; the PM recommends adding it to U-039), and U-111's promotion. Then the experience page (U-039) completes the click-through, about two working days after those answers.

decisionsMade.what: Merged to main: U-030 home (PR 208), U-021a seed data (PR 209), U-031 browse (PR 207); each ran well under its estimate
U-031's FilterBar question withdrawn: the island became a server component, so no allowlist change is needed (PM)
Session day for browse: the date match stays in SQL WHERE and the day list moves to a tested lib function; storing local_date for every session goes to the deep review (PM)
Fixers run in their own worktrees on wip branches; the PM moves the unit branch and pushes (PM, process)
Third promotion: U-045a payments and U-006 email are in main (PR 201; you asked the PM to finish it)
Rolling development to the end of the Prototype: at most 5 builders, Prototype units only, no filler; then a deep review of all work so far (you)
Data units own their tables' read and write contracts; page units own rendering (PM)
Two caller-less functions removed from U-018 until B6 is settled for them (PM)
U-005 pattern note approved on the PM's recommendations (you delegated)
Prototype first with rolling starts: wave 3 is U-012, U-018, U-010, U-111 (plus U-037); pages start as soon as their inputs land; U-019, U-004a, U-091 wait (you)
B3 exemption: the literal process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME guard in src/instrumentation.ts (you)
Fable trial result: builders stay on Sonnet by the rule set in advance; a larger trial is your call
U-003's database client made lazy so CI can build with no database (PM authorization)
Only a blocking finding from a required check starts a review round, for every unit alike

watch.what: Three answers gate the rest of the Prototype
watch.detail: Blob stores, card photos, and U-111's promotion. Everything else in the Prototype is merged or in review.

watch.what: Merging main can break a unit that passed review
watch.detail: U-031 deleted a read that U-021a's new seed test called; no textual conflict. Every merge of main now gets gates and a focused re-check before checks are posted.
U-031 took 7 rounds plus a re-check; U-030 2, U-021a 3. Architecture audits still find B2 items late.
Notes are collecting in drafts/post-prototype-review-notes.md, including the U-030 and U-031 duplicate helpers.
